column1: # Japanese UI strings: English key <TAB> Japanese. The key must match the
# firmware string byte for byte (App/ui/menu.c, main.c and the other screens
# listed in gen_ja_font.py SOURCES). Untranslated keys are shown
# in English. "@width N" sets the pixel limit checked for the lines below it
# (full-width char 12 px, ASCII 7 px, half-width katakana ｱｲｳ 6 px).
# "\n" in a key or translation is a line break. "<menu name>|<value>" is looked
# up before the plain value, for words whose meaning depends on the menu.

menu categories, left column of the category screen
right column of the category screen
right column of the menu screen (values). OFF/ON, numbers, units and
abbreviations (FM, AM, VFO, PTT, VOX, ...) stay in English on purpose.
